root_text:
Our latest study in Vaccines reaffirms the value of SaponiQx’s cultured plant cell QS-21 (cpcQS-21) as a sustainable, scalable alternative to tree-bark QS-21, supporting immunity in HMPV vaccine research.

Read more: https://t.co/S2xBgpMaF1
